summary: Feed s179_triple to NDR is degraded: 40.4% one-way TCP sessions, VLAN 20 completely missing (38% untagged), and encrypted share 90.9% exceeds 90% tolerance. No duplicates, drops, or overload detected.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker/SPAN is delivering only one direction of many flows. Likely asymmetric routing with separate TAP/SPAN sources not aggregated, or a SPAN session configured for tx or rx only, so client->server and server->client are split across different broker ports and not hashed to this NDR port.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR requires both directions (needs_both_directions=true) for TCP reassembly, session tracking and detection. With 78/193 sessions one-way, stateful analysis, IDS signatures and anomaly detection will miss half the conversation and generate false negatives.

recommended_fix.why: Aggregate both directions of each 5-tuple to the same NDR tool port at the packet broker to restore full bidirectional visibility required for NDR.

findings.root_cause: Required VLAN 20 is not seen and 38% of packets are untagged. Most likely VLAN tags are being stripped by a SPAN/mirror port, intermediate switch, or packet broker ingress filter stripping 802.1Q, or the trunk feeding the broker is not forwarding VLAN 20.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR is configured to monitor VLANs 10 and 20. Complete loss of VLAN 20 creates a blind spot; attacks/lateral movement on that segment will not be inspected. Untagged packets also break VLAN-aware policies and filtering.

recommended_fix.why: Configure TAP/trunk and packet broker to preserve 802.1Q tags and explicitly forward VLANs 10 and 20 to this NDR feed so coverage matches tool profile.

findings.root_cause: 91% of bytes are encrypted, just over the NDR's 90% tolerance. Traffic is predominantly TLS/encrypted and is being delivered without prior decryption or selective forwarding, leaving little cleartext payload for inspection.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR needs full payload (needs_full_payload=true) for deep inspection. At 90.9% encrypted, detection coverage is reduced to metadata only; payload signatures, JA3, and content analysis will be ineffective for most flows.

params.suggestion: offload TLS decryption or add selective decrypt/mirror

recommended_fix.why: NDR cannot inspect encrypted payload natively. Decrypt relevant TLS at a dedicated decryption zone/packet broker with keys/HSM or forward copies to a decryption appliance before the NDR, or tune to send only decryptable/interesting traffic to stay under tolerance.
